title: Universality in dimension 1 of kinetically constrained lattice gases
summary: Kinetically constrained lattice gases are interacting particle systems with conserved number of particles, having degenerate rates caused by a kinetic constraint. Over the past decade, there has been major progress in the study of their non-conservative counterpart, kinetically constrained spin models: in dimensions 1 and 2, we have a good understanding of the universality classes of these models.
